acceptanceRepair.initialFinding: A deferred mediaReady failure with a captured but stale source fell through to the unscoped error fallback and could repopulate the current global error.
acceptanceRepair.repair: When a mediaReady source exists, only a currently matching source may set the error; an existing stale source returns without writing. The unscoped fallback is retained only when no source can be constructed.
acceptanceRepair.regression: A deferred old-revision mediaReady failure is released after revision recovery, followed by checks that a current mediaReady failure remains visible and matching capability success clears it.

independentStaticVerification.method: Read-only source assertions and control-flow review on the stable WIP snapshot
resizeDragConfirmed: Drag start reads the actual panel getBoundingClientRect dimensions and position
Actual DOM width and height are synchronized into the component size before movement
Movement uses actual offsetWidth and offsetHeight for viewport clamping
The floating panel uses border-box sizing and viewport maximum width and height
The regression fixture overrides DOM geometry to 760 by 480 and does not mutate reactive size
The fixture asserts 760 by 480 is retained after drag and the final left/top are viewport constrained
errorCleanupConfirmed: Signal error provenance records lifecycle, media context, context revision, negotiation, and capability
Late description and ICE failures write only when their captured source remains current
Revision recovery clears only the tracked stale signal error code and does not clear capability errors
Capability recovery requires the same media context and capability source
A captured but stale mediaReady source is ignored instead of falling through to the unscoped fallback
The regressions cover late old-negotiation failure, current failure recovery, coexistence with another capability error, and deferred stale mediaReady failure
